person_note: The controlling narrator is a nonparticipating third-person voice that moves among characters including Denny, Bruce, and Mercer and can report their inner states. The sustained Goodreads scenes agree with the authorized third-person opening and whole-book web descriptions. First-person forms in the quote set occur in dialogue or gnomic remarks and are local character voices, not autonomous narrative sections. No evidence of second-person or alternating base narration was found. The main scope limitation is that the authorized excerpt covers only the opening, but interior quote evidence and independent whole-book analyses consistently corroborate THIRD.
